# Pocket of Preschool

> A comprehensive resource hub for play-based preschool and early childhood education featuring themed activities, literacy and math centers, and classroom management strategies.

Created by Jackie and featured on Teachers Pay Teachers, Pocket of Preschool offers hands-on, developmentally appropriate activities organized by curriculum areas and themes. The site emphasizes play-based learning, social-emotional development, and STEM exploration for preschool and kindergarten classrooms.

## Key Topics

- Preschool activities
- Play-based learning
- Themed centers
- Math and literacy activities
- Social-emotional learning (SEL)
- Dramatic play
- STEM and hands-on learning
- Sensory activities
- Fine motor skills
- Classroom management
- Editable curriculum planning
- Early childhood education
- Kindergarten activities
- Free resources
- Themed curriculum bundles

## Core Curriculum Areas

- [Math](https://pocketofpreschool.com/math): Math activities and counting resources for preschool curriculum
- [Literacy](https://pocketofpreschool.com/literacy): Literacy activities and letter recognition resources for preschool
- [Science](https://pocketofpreschool.com/science): STEM science investigations and activities for early childhood
- [Social Emotional](https://pocketofpreschool.com/social-emotional): SEL activities and emotions curriculum for preschool classrooms

## Learning Centers & Play

- [Centers](https://pocketofpreschool.com/centers): Math and literacy centers collection including themed activities
- [Dramatic Play](https://pocketofpreschool.com/dramatic-play): Dramatic play centers and pretend play themes for preschool
- [Sensory](https://pocketofpreschool.com/sensory): Sensory activities including bins, bottles, and play dough resources

## Themes & Curriculum

- [Themes](https://pocketofpreschool.com/themes): Theme-based curriculum resources and lesson plans for preschool
- [Book Lists](https://pocketofpreschool.com/book-lists): Curated book lists for themed reading and literacy activities

## Teaching Resources & Guidance

- [Teaching Tips](https://pocketofpreschool.com/teaching-tips): Teaching tips and classroom management strategies for early childhood
- [Blog](https://pocketofpreschool.com/blog): Blog index with preschool activities, themes, and teaching resources

## About & Navigation

- [Home](https://pocketofpreschool.com): Homepage for Pocket of Preschool by Jackie with preschool activities and resources
- [About Me](https://pocketofpreschool.com/about-me): About Jackie and Pocket of Preschool, featured on Teachers Pay Teachers

## Optional

- [Videos](https://pocketofpreschool.com/videos_archive): YouTube video archive of preschool activities and themed lessons
